description_id: Bundle skill + template Social Conductor v2 (Option B scope). Content calendar, post drafting cross-platform, engagement log, voice-consistency checker. NO scraping, NO auto-post — kamu yang submit ke platform.

skills.description_id: Locked brand voice profile dari 20+ sample writing. Reference yang dipakai semua draft skill untuk fit-score.
skills.description_en: Lock brand voice profile from 20+ samples; reference for all draft skills.

skills.description_id: Susun content calendar lintas platform (TikTok, Reels, X, LinkedIn, blog). Slot terjadwal di local DB, bukan di platform 3rd-party. Output bisa di-export ke .ics atau Google Calendar manual.
skills.description_en: Build cross-platform content calendar in local DB.

skills.description_id: Draft post copy per platform — caption length-adjusted (TikTok ~150, Reels ~125, X ~280, LinkedIn ~700). Voice-fit scored. Customer copy-paste ke platform manual.
skills.description_en: Draft platform-optimal post copy in locked voice.

skills.description_id: Log comment / DM / mention yang customer input manual. Track yang belum dibalas, surface daily digest. Draft reply siap customer kirim manual.
Skor fit setiap draft (post / reply / DM) ke locked voice profile. Output: high/medium/low fit + saran tweak kalau medium/low. Track drift trend mingguan.
skills.description_en: Score draft fit to locked voice profile.

skills.description_id: Multi-week campaign plan (produk launch, content series, seasonal push). Output: calendar entries + post drafts pre-staged + engagement triggers.
skills.description_en: Multi-week campaign plan with calendar + drafts.

skills.description_id: Playbook 8 langkah yang menjalankan satu campaign multi-minggu dari plan sampai semua slot terposting dan engagement tertangani. Dua titik henti: customer approve plan di awal, lalu reminder H-2 per slot sebelum jam posting target. Posting tetap kamu yang submit, aku draft dan ingatkan.
skills.description_en: 8-step playbook running one multi-week campaign from plan through all slots posted and engagement tracked. Two checkpoints: plan approval at start, then recurring H-2 reminder per slot before posting time. Customer submits posts; agent drafts and reminds.

skills.description_id: Generate skill atau template baru saat customer minta sesuatu yang belum ada di inventory.
skills.description_en: Generate a new skill or template at runtime when the customer asks for something not in inventory.

skills.description_id: Playbook enam langkah yang menyetel voice brand customer sebelum draft mode aktif — intake, kumpulkan minimum 20 sample, lock profile via voice-locker, generate 5 draft uji coba, checkpoint rate-fit, lalu aktifkan atau re-lock berdasarkan rating.
skills.description_en: Six-step playbook that locks the customer's brand voice before drafting goes live — intake, collect at least 20 samples, lock the profile via voice-locker, generate 5 test drafts, a rate-the-fit checkpoint, then activate or re-lock based on the rating.

templates.description_id: Schema voice profile — register, banned words, signature phrases, length norms, emoji policy.
Schema calendar entries — platform, date, status (draft/scheduled/posted), tema, content type.
Cadence presets — solopreneur (3/week), brand (daily mixed), creator (1-2/day with batch).
Length budget per platform untuk post-drafter.
Schema engagement log — source, type (comment/DM/mention), priority, status (pending/replied/escalated), draft reply.
Reply patterns per situasi — appreciative, clarifying, redirect-to-DM, escalation flag.
Rubric scoring high/medium/low fit. Specific signals per voice dimension.
Campaign plan template — phase, week-by-week deliverables, KPI hooks.
